name: Flair's Famous Figure Four
Text: When you are The Four Horsemen, cannot be reversed when played after a successfully played maneuver. This card is +2D for every maneuver with 'leg', 'ankle', or 'chop block' in the title in your Ring. Shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and when your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text.

name: Flair's Robe
Text: When packing this card, you may pack 4 additional Pre-match cards, your Ric Flair-specific Pre-match cards do not count for your opponent's I'm Gonna Break You and the first 2 played do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your 16-Time Heavyweight Champion cards are Multi, The Game Interferes! now reads 'Reverse any maneuver' instead, and Revolution The Founder of the Four Horsemen adds to your Ability instead of replacing it. The number of cards removed for Yesterday Is So Long Ago is reduced to 0.

name: Following 'The Game Plan'
Text: Put up to 1 card from Ringside, up to 1 card removed from the game, and up to 1 non-unique non-reversal card from your Ring into your hand. Draw 1 card, shuffle up to 1 card from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and your opponent discards 1 random card; when you are The Rock, double all numbers in this sentence.

name: From the Bottomless Pit
Text: When packing this card, you may pack non-reversal Volley cards. Your The Tick Tock of the Clock cards do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your Boogeyman-specific actions are Multi, and replace the 'Can only be played' text with 'Cannot be reversed' on your ...And I'm Coming to Getcha! cards.

name: Full-Blooded Italians
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw up to 2 cards. Do not discard for Armageddon Is Upon Us. Your FBI-specific maneuvers are now Multi and also Trademark Finishers, and your opponent cannot play reversals to your FBI Hit List.

name: G.T.S.
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F and when played as the first card of your turn, it is Multi. When this card is successfully played and it is not reversed from Arsenal, you win the game via Pinfall Victory. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card.

name: Getting a 418 Energy Boost!
Text: When you have lower Fortitude, this card is -4F. When you have equal Fortitude, this card is -1F. Shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, where # is equal to the number of Uniques in your Ring and cannot be greater than 8. When your Ability is blank, you may also draw # cards.

name: Getting an Edge on the Competition
Text: Before the Draw Segment of the first turn of the game, put this card into your Ring. When you are X-Treme Diva, you may then draw 2 cards.

name: Getting Some Old School Payback!
Text: Cannot be packed by The Home Team. Can be played regardless of Find Out How To Fight From Finlay. When you successfully play a maneuver from under another card 'as if from hand', you may draw 1 card and then discard 1 card; when you do and you do not have Back to Basics in your Ring, after damage is applied end your turn.

name: Giant Bear Hug
Text: Draw 1 card and put 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Give Yourself a Hand!
Text: Cannot be reversed and cannot be blanked. Your opponent overturns cards equal to double the number of Puppies! Puppies! in your Ring, then shuffle all your Puppies! Puppies! cards in your Ring and Ringside into your Arsenal and draw up to 2 cards. ACE: During your turn when this card is in your Ring or Ringside, you may remove 2 Puppies! Puppies! cards in your Ring and/or Ringside from the game, then put this card in your Backlash. This effect cannot be reversed.

name: Giving You 'The Rundown'
Text: Search your Arsenal and Ringside for 2 The Rock-specific maneuvers, reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When the next card played this turn was revealed by this card, it cannot be reversed from hand. When you are The Rock, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Goldust's Wig
Text: Search your Arsenal for any number of Goldust-specific cards, reveal them, and put them in your Backlash deck; they are now considered Mid-match cards until successfully played or reversed. Your Goldust-specific actions cannot be reversed. Ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on your Goldust-specific maneuvers, and when you have no BASH cards in your Ring, ignore the 'Set-up' text on Butt Bump.

name: Good Friends With Mr. McMahon
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your William Regal-specific Pre-match cards and your Backstage Politics do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your Superstar-specific Mid-match cards are Multi. When Backstage Politics is in your Ring, your Proper Planning Prevents Piss-Poor Performance is Permanent, and ignore the 'when overturned' text on your I've Been Besmirched! cards.

name: Grab a 40 and Check Your Rollies!
Text: You may reveal 1 card in your opponent's Ring under another card; when there is more than 1 card under it, choose 1 randomly. If you do, the chosen card is put into his Ringside, and you may search your Arsenal for 1 card with the same title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. If you do not, choose 1 card in his Ring. This card gains the text of that card.

name: Handicap Match
Text: Can only be packed when you can pack the Tag Team Title Belts. Can only be played when your opponent cannot pack the Tag Team Title Belts. Your Starting Hand Size is +1, and his Starting Hand Size is -1; your Pre-match and Mid-match Capacity are +2; and once during each of his turns, when you reverse a maneuver from hand, put up to 1 random card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. You cannot play The Champ Is Here.

name: Hawk's Flying Clothesline
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F. As a reversal, reverse any non-unique non-maneuver card.

name: He'll Beat You Syxx Ways From Sunday
Text: You may put Outsider Distraction from your Backlash into your Ring, and that card is now Permanent. Your Leaping Spin Kick is now Multi. You may increase your Starting Hand Size by 4.

name: Head of The J.O.B. Squad
Text: Your Tough Enough Head Trainer is Permanent and replace 'Can only be played' text with 'Cannot be reversed'; ignore the µSet-up' text on your Snow Slide cards, and replace the 'played' text with 'reversed by Unique reversals' on your Snow Plow. Once during each of your turns, you may either discard 3 cards to put No Gimmicks Needed from your Ringside into your Ring, or when Head is removed from the game, discard 2 cards to put it into your hand.

name: Hell's Henchmen - Don't Hunt the Hunter
Text: When this card is packed, you may pack Don't Try This at Home, and Drinking Beer - Raising Hell - Kicking Ass is not Smackdown, and its Activated Card Effect cannot be reversed. Your APA-specific cards are -5F, and your Dominator and Clothesline from Hell cards are now Trademark Finishers instead.

name: Here Comes the Cavalry!
Text: Cannot be packed when you can pack Tag Team Title Belts or by a Stable. Recover 8- Ringside cards and draw 2- cards. When your Ability has 'enforcer' in the text, you may change your Enforcer. When your opponent can pack Tag Team Title Belts, they discard 2 and overturn 2.

name: Heyman's Cult-like Following
Text: Shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, where # is equal to the number of ECW cards in your Ring. You may reveal 1 Enforcer card and you may choose a new Enforcer. When this card is in your Ring area, before your Draw Segment, you may shuffle it into your Arsenal.

name: High-Flying Hurricanrana
Text: Can be packed by Funaki. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card. When you are Funaki or when played after Springboard, this card is -6F. As a reversal, this card is -5F and -5D, reverse any non-Unique Grapple maneuver.
Type: High Risk + High Risk / Reversal: Special

name: High-Flying Style
Text: Can only be packed by X-Pac, Jeff Hardy, Matt Hardy, Lita, Tajiri, Hurricane, Rey Mysterio, MNM, X-treme Diva, Mexicools, Chavo Guerrero, Funaki, Kenny, Revolution Sabu, Owen Hart, The Blue Blazer, Latino Cheat, and Johnny Nitro. Your Strike maneuvers with µrana' in the title are now High Risk maneuvers instead, and your opponent's non-unique reversals to your High Risk maneuvers deal no damage. Your From the Top Rope and From the Middle Turnbuckle cards cannot be reversed.

name: His Hands and Feet Are Lethal Weapons
Text: Your Educated Feet and Educated Hands cards do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring, and your Roll Out of the Ring cards cannot be reversed. Ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on your Tajiri-specific cards (except Series of Kicks). When you reverse a card from hand or Backlash and your Fortitude Rating is 10-, you may put 1 non-Multi 6D- card with 'kick' or 'handspring' in the title from your hand into your Ring, and your opponent overturns 3 cards.

name: Hit With Whatever's Available
Text: When Hornswoggle! is in your Ringside, this card cannot be reversed from Backlash or by hybrid reversals. When The Shillelagh is in your Ringside, this card is +5D, and when this card is successfully played, put The Shillelagh into your hand. Your opponent discards cards equal to the number of non-hybrid D: 3+ maneuvers in your Ring.

name: Hogan Knows Best
Text: When you are Hollywood Hulk Hogan, this card is -10F. Reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card.

name: Hollywood Hogan, Syxx, or Kevin Nash...?
Text: Cannot be packed by a GM, except Eric Bischoff.  Hidden: when your nWo card is successful, reveal this card and you may choose a new Enforcer. ≥ Hand Size: +7 Superstar Value: +6 Superstar Ability: +Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 3 and Arsenal Search 1 maneuver that is not Unique, Throwback, Submission, or High Risk. ≥ Hand Size: +6 Superstar Value: +2 Superstar Ability: +During your Draw Segment, draw 2 more cards and discard 1. ≥ Hand Size: +6 Superstar Value: +4 Superstar Ability: +Your 'Bomb,' 'Power,' and 'Slam' cards are -3F and +3D, and they are Multi when you have no Ring 'Bomb,' 'Power,' or 'Slam' maneuvers.

name: Hometown Hero
Text: *This card is always considered revealed. Cannot be packed by Doink. All Universally Active Venues are Active instead, and cannot be blanked. You can play a Venue when your opponent has a Venue in their Ring. When both players have a Ring Venue, and you have a non-Superstar-specific Ring Venue, your Hand Size is -2.

name: Hornswoggle!
Text: When this card is hidden, during your opponent's turn when you have less than 15 cards in your Arsenal, when he plays a maneuver, reveal this card to blank that card. You may then put Hornswoggle! into your Ringside to completely reverse the maneuver. This card can be moved to your Arsenal, but can only be moved from the Ringside by Finlay-specific cards. When overturned, reverse any non-unique maneuver.

name: Hung Out To Dry, Horsemen Style
Text: As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card. When successfully played, put up to 1 Backlash card from your Ringside into your Backlash.

name: I Am Not a Nugget!
Text: Reverse any non-unique maneuver and search your Arsenal for It's Time For a Change, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: I Am What I Say I Am...
Text: As an action, draw up to 3 cards. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for ...and That's Perfect!, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: I Lied, Homes!
Text: During your turn when you have 10F or more, when your opponent reverses a maneuver played from hand, you may put this card from your hand into your Ring and put the reversed maneuver back into your hand. After resolving his reversal, your turn continues.

name: I'll Be an Instant Classic!
Text: You may put a maneuver of D:4 or less from your hand into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring, you may remove cards of D:3 or less with your Ability, and your action cards are Permanent. When this card is in your Ringside, you may discard 3 cards and then put it in your hand.

name: I'll Show You - You'll See!
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique maneuver, reveal it, then search your Arsenal for 1 card, put both cards in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: I'll Show You Some 'Old School Wrestling!'
Text: Your Ability reads 'During your opponent's turns, when he plays a non-Superstar-specific card with 'reverse' in the text, he discards 1 card.' Search your Arsenal for 6 cards and place them under this card. You may play a Manager card during the Venue phase. At the end of the Pre-match phase, shuffle the cards under this card into your Arsenal, and put There Is No Escape from your Backlash into your Ring. When Back to Basics is in your Ring, you can play any maneuver regardless of There Is No Escape.

name: I'll Taunt You, Then I'll BASH You!
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When Yo! Kill da Beat! is in your opponent's Ring, your maneuvers are -3F. ACE: During his turn, when he successfully plays a Unique card, you may put this card in your Ringside and then he overturns 6 cards.

name: I'm Comin'!
Text: This card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your maneuvers cannot be reversed from Ring, and your opponent may not play Restricted Use in this Area. When this card is in your Ringside, your maneuvers are +1D and +1 Stun Value.

name: I'm Gonna BASH Your Brains In!
Text: Your Pre-match and Mid-match Capacity is +2. Your opponent cannot play I'm Gonna Break You. ACE: During you're his turn, you may remove this card from the game to reverse a card that 'cannot be reversed'.

name: I'm Here To Save Us.. From You!
Text: Reverse any non-Unique maneuver or Activated Card Effect. You may put You Sanctimonious Son of a B!tch from your Backlash into your Ring.

name: I'm Not Driven By Fear
Text: When packing this card, your Chris Benoit-specific cards are not Cheater or Fan Favorite. Your 20 Years: From the Dungeon to the WWE cards, your Kurt Angle-Superstar-specific cards, and your Superstar-specific Mid-match actions are Multi. Your Superstar-specific Mid-match cards are -6F. Your Chris Benoit-specific cards do not take a Pre-match slot in your Ring. When your opponent successfully plays a Revolution maneuver, you may search for any non-unique maneuver instead with your Ability.

name: I'm Sick of This 'Extremely Crappy Wrestling'
Text: When your opponent has an ECW card in his Ring, this card is Multi; when you are Jerry Lawler, he cannot play reversals to it. Remove up to 1 Foreign Object and any number of Steel Chain Shot cards in his Ringside, and 1 up to Foreign Object in his Ring from the game. Search your Arsenal for up to 1 non-unique maneuver that is not a Foreign Object or Extreme, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: I'm Straight-Edge
Text: When your opponent reverses a maneuver from his hand, and that maneuver had no modifications from your cards, draw 1 card and he randomly discards 1 card. Your Revolution Straight-Edge card is now 'Reversal: non-Trademark Finisher' instead, and when you do not have a maneuver in your Ring, that card is -9F. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may overturn 4 cards to put it in your Backlash.

name: I've Been Everywhere, but ECW is My Home
Text: Shuffle cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal up to double the number of ECW cards in your Ring and draw up to 2 cards.

name: I've Got a Present, Just For You!
Text: During your turn, you may put this card from any non-Ring Area into your Ring. When you do, put 1 random Arsenal card under this card as a 'present'. Your opponent may decline the 'present'; if he does, put that card in your Backstage, Bury 3- Ringside cards and draw 2- cards, and your next maneuver this turn cannot be reversed by Your Reach Exceeds Your Grasp. If he accepts the 'present', reveal the card; if it is a reversal, both players shuffle 3- Ringside cards and draw 2- cards; if it is not, he overturns 3 cards and discards 2 cards, and you may put this card into your Backstage.

name: If You Desire It, We'll Acquire It
Text: During your turn when you have not played any cards this turn and this card is in your hand, put this card into your Ring. Your opponent may search his Arsenal for 1 card and put it into his hand; if he does, he then discards 2 cards, you may search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and all players shuffle their Arsenals. If your opponent does not search, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside or 1 card removed from the game into your hand.

name: Intimidated by Undertaker's Mystique
Text: Can only be packed by Undertaker. Cannot be packed when packing Corners. Your Starting Hand Size is +2 and your Managed by Paul Bearer is Permanent. Your Undertaker-specific actions are Multi.

name: Irish Whip
Text: Your Lock, Stock, and Barrel maneuvers are blank. During your turn when this card is in your Backlash, you may put it into your Ring. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may discard 2 cards and then put this card into your Backlash. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards and then your next card played this turn is considered to be played after Irish Whip and after a Set-up card.

name: Is She Crazy or Just Crafty?
Text: When packing this card, your Hide and Seek and Vise Lock cards are not Cheater, and when this card is revealed, they are Multi. During your turn, you may hide this card and for each card in your Ring that has cards under it, put up to 1 card from your Ringside under that card.

name: Is That All You Got?
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver, after damage is resolved, end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring, his maneuver cards with µreverse' in the text are blank when played. During his turn when this card is in your Ring, he may discard 4 cards from hand or Backlash and then remove this card from the game.

name: It's Mick Foley and His Mystery Wrestler!
Text: When packing this card, you may also pack other Enforcer cards (except Shane O' Mac... or Stephanie?), they have no brands. When you reveal the Mankind/Cactus Jack, or... Dude Love? Enforcer card, reveal 1 additional Enforcer card. Whenever you choose an Enforcer, you may choose 1 additional Enforcer from the Mankind/Cactus Jack, or... Dude Love? Card. Your Starting Hand Size cannot be greater than 8.

name: It's Not the Size of the Dog in the Fight...
Text: Cannot be blanked. Do not discard for Armageddon Is Upon Us. Replace the 'Grapple' text with 'non-Trademark Finisher' on your Superstar-specific Mid-match reversals, ignore 'Can only be playedα' text on Giant Killer, and do not discard for Brotherly Love. ACE: You may put Brotherly Love from your Ring into your Ringside to reverse an Activated Card Effect.

name: It's Time For a Change
Text: Cannot be reversed when Enough Is Enough is in your Ring. Choose 1 card in your opponent's Ring, that card is blank. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, look at his hand and choose 2 cards, he shuffles those cards into his Arsenal. Draw up to 3 cards.

name: Jamie Noble is In My Corner!
Text: Packed: you can pack non-maneuver non-Virtual non-'Interferes' Jamie Noble-specific cards. Your first 'Trailer Park' card played each turn cannot be reversed. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 Nidia-specific Pre-match card from your Backlash into your Ring.

name: Jericho's Running Bulldog
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. Cannot be reversed when played after a successfully played 8D or greater maneuver.

name: Johnny Nitro
Text: When you reverse a card to end your opponent's turn and your first card played on your next turn is a High Risk, it is considered to be played after the reversed card. Your Melina: Naughty Manager cards are F: 0. You may pack non-maneuver MNM cards.

name: JTG's Drop Kick
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be reversed from Backlash. Your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Just Call Me 'DAVE'
Text: Your non-Unique maneuvers with 'spine' in the title are +2D, and when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, they are Chain. When you have 6+ non-Backlash Batista-specific cards in your Ring, your Batista Bomb cannot be reversed from Arsenal by non-Unique cards. During your turn, you may hide this card and then put 1 Batista-specific card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Kane's Hook
Text: When you are Kane, this is card is -20F and Multi. When your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it can only be reversed from Backlash and Arsenal.

name: Keeping My Identity a Secret
Text: Cannot be packed by The Hurri-friends. Packed: you may pack The Hurri-Friends' Armory, it is a Unique Event instead, not Universally Active, and cannot be blanked or blocked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +3. Ignore 'Can be reversed...' on your Hurrislam. When you have F: 7-, your non-Unique maneuvers can only be reversed by D: 0 reversals.

name: Kennedy's Cheap Shot
Text: Can only be played when your opponent successfully plays a maneuver. After damage is resolved, end his turn.

name: Ladder
Text: This card is also considered Ladder in the Ring for card effects. When playing an Extreme of printed 5D or greater, Grapple, Throw, High Risk, Trademark or Trademark Finisher without 'Maintain' in the text, you may choose this card until that maneuver finishes resolving. ACE: When this card is chosen, put this card into your Ringside and then your successfully played maneuver is +6D and +3 Stun Value.

name: Ladies and Gentlemen, Boys and Girls, Children of all Ages...
Logos: New Age Outlaws, Billy Gunn, Road Dogg
Text: This card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your Superstar-specific actions are Multi, and replace 'Strike, Grapple' on your Superstar-specific reversals with 'non-Trademark Finisher.' When you are Road Dogg, search your Arsenal for Let's Make Some Noise, put it into your Ring, and shuffle; that card is now Permanent and you do not draw cards for that card when you would discard cards for a card effect from your Ringside; when your first non-reversal card played during the game is a maneuver, it can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Lashley's Two-Finger Salute to the Fans
Text: Cannot be blanked. You cannot play more than 2 maneuvers each turn, and you cannot play Maintain Hold. Your maneuvers are -3F and +2D, your Volley: # maneuvers are Volley: #+3, and your printed Multi BASH maneuvers are F:0. Your opponent cannot play Elbow to the Face to your printed 6D- maneuvers that are not Chain, Heat, Volley, Multi, Revolution, or hybrid.

name: Latino Cheat
Text: Do not draw cards during your Draw Segment; instead, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. You cannot play any card with the same title as a card in your Ring. Do not discard cards for Armageddon Is Upon Us. You can pack Eddie Guerrero cards, and The Three Amigos, Guerreros por Siempre, and A Family Tradition. You cannot pack Redemption.

name: Legendary Animalistic Offense
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your opponent does not discard for JYD's Chain. Your ’DDT’ Grapples are -4F. He discards 1 extra card to reverse a Chain maneuver from hand or Backlash, and when your Chain card is successful, discard 1 less card to search your Arsenal for a Chain card.

name: Legendary Road Warrior Face Paint
Text: Shuffle up to 8 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game, overturn 2 cards and then draw up to 4 cards.

name: Legendary Teamwork
Text: When you are The Road Warriors and you have lower Fortitude, this card is -5F. Reverse any Activated Card Effect, or when your opponent has a maneuver in his Ring, reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver, and put up to 1 card from your Ringside or up to 1 card removed from the game in your hand.

name: Legendary Women's Champion
Text: When packing this card, you may pack maneuvers of 3D, and cards as if you were a Legend, but you are not considered a Legend. You may increase your Starting Hand Size by 3.

name: Lucha Libre Style Champion
Text: Ignore the 'Once' text on your That's Value. Once during each of your turns, when you play Springboard, you may discard 1 card to ignore the 'Can only be played...' text.

name: Macho Madness
Text: When packing this card, your cards with 'Blindside' in the title are not Cheater or Fan Favorite. You may play this card from Ringside. When you remove more than 1 card from the game to play a maneuver or reversal from Ringside with 'Blindside' in the title, the number of cards removed is reduced to 1. Your Blindsided Rage cards cannot be blanked.

name: Macho Man Randy Savage
Text: Your cards with 'elbow' in the title are +4D. When the first card you play on your turn is From the Top Rope, it cannot be reversed.

name: Maintained Offensive
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Search your Arsenal for 1 maneuver that shares a word of 4 or more letters in its title with the played maneuver, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When that maneuver is the next card played this turn, this card is not considered to have been played, and you may play that maneuver as though it was played after the previous maneuver.

name: Malenko's Texas Cloverleaf
Text: As a maneuver, when your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, you may ignore the 'Can only be played...' text. As an action, this card is -30F, put this card and up to 3 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal and then draw up to 1 card.

name: Managed by 'Classy' Freddie Blassie
Text: Ignore 'Can only be played...' on your Pencil-Necked Geek. ACE: During your turn you may Eliminate this card and then Bury 3- of your RFG cards; when you are a Legend, your opponent overturns 8.

name: Managed by Bobby 'The Brain' Heenan
Text: Can only be packed by a Legend. Cannot be played when your opponent is Bobby Heenan or a Heenan Family Member. Before each of your Draw Segments, you may look at the top 2 cards of any player's Arsenal; if you look at your Arsenal, you may arrange those cards in any order, or put 1 of them on the bottom of your Arsenal. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 2 cards and discard a card to search your Arsenal for a Heel card of the same card type discarded (if it is a maneuver, the same maneuver type), reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Managed by J.J. Dillon
Text: When your opponent would move this card from your Ring or blank it, you first draw 4 cards. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card in your Ringside and then your next non-Run-in printed 8D- maneuver played this turn can only be reversed from Arsenal and after damage is applied from that maneuver, end your turn; when you have at least 10 lower Fortitude, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: Managed by Miss Elizabeth
Text: When your opponent successfully plays a Heel card, he discards 1 card. ACE: When his Fortitude Rating is 20 or more greater than yours, before his Draw Segment, you may put this card into your Ringside pile, and his turn ends.

name: Managed by Sherri Martel
Text: When your opponent successfully plays a Face card, draw up to 1 card. ACE: During your turn when this card is in your Ring, you may put this card into your Ringside and then shuffle any number of reversals with 'manager' in the title from your Ring and/or Ringside into your Arsenal. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may remove this card from the game to shuffle 2 reversals with 'manager' in the title from your Ring and/or Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Managed by Super Stacy
Text: Your The Hurri-friends Armory card is now a Pre-match Event and is Active instead of Universally Active. When you successfully play a Stacy Keibler card, put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your Starting Hand Size is +5.

name: Manager Distracts
Text: Reverse any card and draw 1 card. When overturned, reverse any non-damage card effect.

name: Masters' Running Boot
Text: When played after Irish Whip, this card is -10F. As a reversal, this card is -10D, reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card.

name: Matt Facts
Text: Can only be packed by Matt Hardy. Your Mattitude Adjustment can also reverse any non-Unique maneuver. Your non-hybrid Matt Hardy-specific actions are now Multi, and your Spinning Straight Elbow is a High Risk instead.

name: Matt's Diving Lariat
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card; when your opponent is MVP or you do not have a Corner card in your Ring, this card is -4F and +4D. As an action, this card is D:0, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside in your hand and put 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card and Stronger Than Death are in your Ring and you are The Ultimate Survivor, you may use your Ability twice per turn.

name: Melina
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card, and then your opponent reveals 3 random cards in his hand; choose 1, and he discards the chosen card. He may not play any cards with 'Melina' in the title. You may not pack maneuvers of 6D or greater unless they have 'choke' or 'kick' in the title. You may pack Girly Choke. Ignore the Requirement of your Revolution Melina's Shoot Stretch cards.

name: Melina's Boot Choke
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. Cannot be reversed from Backlash when played after Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. When your opponent reverses this card from his Backlash, he overturns 4 cards. Draw up to 1 card.

name: Melina's Scream
Text: When your Fortitude is 10 or more and you reversed a card to end your opponent's turn, you may put this card into your Ring from your hand. When this card is in your Ring, he discards 1 card after completely reversing your maneuver from hand or Backlash. When he successfully plays a maneuver, put this card into your Ringside.

name: Mister P-P-V!
Text: Cannot be reversed from Hand. Recover #- RFG cards and #- Ringside cards (# = High Risks in your Ring). ACE: When you would lose the game, you may put this card under your Superstar card and then the game continues, Recover 4- Ringside cards and 4- random Ringside cards, and your next card played on your turn is -20F and +20F to reverse.

Text: Can only be packed by a Revolution Superstar. Your first Core played each turn cannot be reversed by Elbow to the Face, Clumsy Opponent, or Me Llamo...Armando Alejandro Estrrrrrada. Your printed 24F+ Trademark: Colossals, Revolution West Coast Pop and Revolution The Elijah Express are also considered Trademark Finishers.

name: The Road Warriors
Text: You play the first card in each phase of Pre-match regardless of Superstar Value. Your maneuver cards are not Heel. You may pack No Sell Maneuver cards, but you may not pack Face action cards. You are a Tag Team.

name: The Rock Concert
Text: Cannot be packed by The People's Champ. Packed: you may pack 2 more Pre-match cards, and your This Is The Rock's Show is not Cheater. Your opponent's I'm Gonna Break You is blocked. ACE: During your turn you may Eliminate this card and then choose one: Ringside Search 3- Unique actions, or put Shades Of the Great One from your Ringside into your Ring.

name: The Self-Destruction of The Ultimate-Warrior
Text: Put up to 1 non-maneuver card in your opponent's Ring in their Ringside. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 maneuver from your Ring into your Ringside and then put 1 card from his Ring with Damage equal to or less than the Damage of your maneuver into his Ringside.

name: The Sexy Beast
Text: You can pack I Have a Major Announcement in your Backstage, but you cannot pack it in your Backlash. It is not Fan Favorite, and it cannot be blanked; at the end of the Pre-match phase, put that card in your Ring, and ignore the 'You cannot play...' text. Your opponent resolves first at the end of the Pre-match phase, regardless of Superstar Value. You can pack Chris Jericho cards; ignore 'Superstar' on your Chris Jericho-specific Backlash cards.

name: The Shillelagh
Text: When successfully played as a maneuver, this card is +5D, and you choose one: your opponent discards his hand or Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card. When successfully played, you may shuffle Hornswoggle! from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: The Sleeper Match of the Year!
Text: Cannot be reversed when played by Rowdy Roddy Piper or after a card with 'sleeper' in the title. When you successfully play a maneuver with 'sleeper' in the title, your opponent discards 1 card and you draw up to 1 card. When you have 7 or more cards with 'sleeper' in the title in your Ring, you have at least 10 greater Fortitude, and you have more cards in hand, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: The Stylin' Strut
Text: This card is considered non-Unique for The Best Thing Going Today.When your Fortitude Rating is 15+ and this card is in your Backlash, after successfully playing a maneuver and damage is resolved, you may put this card into your Ring. When this card enters your Ring, your opponent may discard 3 reversals; if he does, your turn ends.  If he does not, you may draw 3 cards or search your Arsenal or Ringside for a card with 'whoo' in the title, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle; and the next card played this turn is considered to have 'chop' in the title.

name: The Summer Of Love
Text: When you are not packing Enforcers, replace the µnon-unique' text with µnon-superstar' in your Ability. Once during each of your turns, you may put Split Personalities Have Benefits from your Ring or Ringside (or if it has been removed from the game) into your Backlash. ACE: During your opponent's turn, you may discard 1 Superstar Card to reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card.

name: The Ultimate Opportunist
Text: Your opponent's Antics are also considered Actions. During your turn, you may hide this card and then draw 1 card, put 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, and he discards 1 card.

name: The Ultimate Splash
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. After damage is resolved, put 1 other maneuver from your Ring into your hand.

name: The Ultimate Warrior
Text: When Back to Basics is in your Ring, your maneuvers are Multi and ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversal cards and effects. You may not play more than 2 maneuvers a turn. You may not pack Manager cards or Dallas, Texas. You may pack No Sell Maneuver cards.

name: The Voices Are Getting Louder!
Text: This card and Managed by Stevie Richards do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your Battling the Voices are Multi, and during your turn, ACE: you may remove one of those cards in your Ring from the game to put a Victoria-specific action from your Ringside into your hand. If that card is Backed by Torrie and Candice, you may put that card into your Ring instead.

name: The Wildcat
Text: When packing this card, you may only pack 1 Enforcer (it has no brand), but you may pack up to 6 cards in your Arsenal for Superstars on that Enforcer card. You may not pack Corners. Your Sable-licious card is Permanent, and your Sable Bomb is blank. Once during each of your turns, you may put For the Women Who Want to Be Me from your Ring into your Ringside, and your next card played this turn is -3F.

name: The World's Greatest Tag Team
Text: Choose one: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put any number of Taking Care Of Number One cards from your Backlash into your Ring; or your Ability now reads 'When you successfully play a Hold or Throw, put 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, and when your opponent reverses a Hold or Throw, he discards 1 card.'

name: This Is as Close as You'll Ever Get!
Text: Completely reverse any non-unique maneuver and put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on top of your Arsenal. Look at your opponent's hand, choose up to 2 cards and he puts them on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: This Is For the U.S. of A!
Text: Can only be played if you played a reversal to end your opponent's last turn, and this is the first card played on your turn. When that reversal was a Throwback card, draw up to 2 cards. When your next card played this turn is a Maneuver, it is now a Trademark Finisher instead.

name: This Is Going to be an Old School Brawl!
Text: Can only be played when your opponent plays a maneuver with a reversal restriction from his card that is not his first maneuver with a reversal restriction from his card this turn. Blank that maneuver's text and damage, he discards 2 random cards, and end his turn. When this card is in your Ring and he plays a non-Superstar-specific maneuver with a reversal restriction from his card that is not his first maneuver played this turn with a reversal restriction from his card, he overturns 2 cards.

name: This Is What We Came to the WWF For!
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Corners. Cannot be blanked. When you play a maneuver as a Counter (from hand or Backlash), it is -#F, where # is equal to the number of non-Faction Superstar-specific cards in your Ring. When the reversal was Superstar-specific, triple #. When your first card played each turn is a Superstar-specific action or has 'technical' in the title, it is Multi and ignore 'completely' on reversals and effects to it.

name: This Match WILL Be Perfect!
Text: This card requires 3 reversals to be reversed instead of 2. Can only be played as the first card of your turn. ACE: When your opponent reverses a maneuver from hand, you may put this card into your hand and then remove his reversal card from the game and it is considered to have not been played.

name: Through the Fire and the Flames
Text: Can only be packed by Kane. Your Revolution The Big Red Monster adds to your Ability instead of replacing it, your cards played from hand are -3F when you do not have a D: 1+ Pre-match card in your Ring, and your opponent's reversals to your first Kane-specific action each turn are +8F when you do not have a card with that title in your Ring. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may draw 1 card and then discard 1 card. This effect cannot be reversed.

name: Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle
Text: Your Lock, Stock, and Barrel maneuvers are blank. During your turn, when this card is in your Backlash, you may put it into your Ring. During your turn, when this card is in your Ringside, you may discard 2 cards and then put this card into your Backlash. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards and then your next card played this turn is considered to be played after Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle and after a Set-up card.

name: Time to Change Things Up
Text: Can only be packed when your Ability has 'enforcer' in the text. Cannot be packed by Theodore Long. You may reveal an Enforcer card (except Shane O'Mac or Stephanie?), and choose an additional Enforcer ability until an effect causes you to change Enforcers. Remove the top 3 cards from your Arsenal from the game, and then shuffle 1 card removed from the game into your Arsenal.

name: Time to Face Your 'Doom'
Text: When you are Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson or The Rock, your next maneuver played this turn cannot be reversed from hand. When successfully played and you have 10 or more Movie cards in your Ring, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Too Cool Is In Your Corner!
Text: Cannot be blanked. You cannot play Corners. Your Rikishi-specific Pre-match cards do not take up a slot in your Ring. Your Rikishi-specific cards are Multi. Your Back That A%$ Up now reads ‘Can only be played as a Counter. When Successful, Arsenal / Ringside Search Stinkface.’

name: Total Teamwork
Text: Can only be packed by a Tag Team Superstar, except by The Home Team or The Heat Seekers. As an action, can only be played if you reversed a card to end your opponent's turn, and this is the first card played on your turn. When your next card played is a maneuver, it can only be reversed from Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-unique maneuver and draw up to 2 cards.

name: Trash Can
Text: When this card becomes successful, you may choose to reduce the Damage to 0. If you do, this card is considered to be resolved, your opponent may not play reversals to it, and when your next card played this turn is a Strike, he cannot play reversals to it.

name: Turn the Match Around
Text: You may search for this card as if it was non-Unique. You may play your next card this turn as if you had your opponent's Fortitude rating. When you have a Revolution card in your Ring, he plays reversals to your next card this turn as if he had your Fortitude rating.

name: Turn Up the Trouble
Text: Search your Arsenal for up to 1 non-unique action, up to 1 non-unique maneuver, and up to 1 non-unique reversal, reveal them to your opponent, randomly shuffle 1 card back into your Arsenal, and put the remaining cards into your hand. He chooses 2 cards in his hand, randomly shuffles 1 into his Arsenal, and reveals the other card.

name: Ultimo Re-Chavo
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark Finisher-maneuver. When your first card played on your next turn is a maneuver, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text.

name: Unbreakable
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 Submission maneuver, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring area, your Submission maneuvers are Multi.

name: Underhanded Tactics
Text: When you are The Radicalz or Latino Cheat, this card is F: 0 and Multi. Search your Arsenal for 1 card, reveal it, put it under this card, and shuffle your Arsenal. Once during each of your turns, you may put a card under this card into your hand, and then put a card from your hand under this card. When this card is moved from the Ring, shuffle the card under it into your Arsenal.

name: Unorthodox Style of Wrestling
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is 10 or less, your first maneuver played each turn is now High Risk instead and Unique. Your Follow-up maneuvers are also considered High Risk maneuvers. Ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on Jeff Hardy-specific actions. During your turn, you may play Whisper In the Wind as if it was a High Risk maneuver with the text 'Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver.'

name: Unstoppable Force
Text: When you are Brock Lesnar, Rhyno, or Lashley, draw up to 2 cards. For the rest of this turn and your next 2 turns, your opponent's reversals (except Over Sell Maneuver) successfully played from hand are blank for the rest of that turn and deal no damage.

name: Vince McMahon's 'Kiss My A$%' Club
Text: This card cannot be blanked. Your opponent's Managed by Eric Bischoff is blank. At the end of the Pre-match phase, he may randomly discard 2 cards; if he does, draw up to 2 cards or put 1 card from your Ringside into your hand. If he does not, before each of your Draw Segments, he overturns 1 card. Your Zero Tolerance: Kiss My Magnificent A%$ cards cannot be reversed by Elbow to the Face.

name: Vive La Resistance!
Text: This card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring, nor does your Managed by Fifi. Your Rene Dupree-specific actions and Rene Dupree-specific Grapples are considered Multi, and your The French Neck Breaker now reads 'When successfully played, you may put 1 Backlash card removed from the game or in your Ringside into your Backlash.' ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and then put 1 non-Unique card from your Ring into your hand, and shuffle up to 3 non-Unique cards from your Ring into your Arsenal. This effect cannot be reversed.

name: Warrior's Lariat
Text: When successfully played, search your Arsenal and Ringside for Shaking the Ropes, put it in your hand, and shuffle your Arsenal.

name: Warrior's Old School Dash to the Ring
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Your Press Slam is TMF instead, and when successful, Arsenal Search The Ultimate Splash. At the end of the Pre-match phase, when you have 6- Ring cards, you may put Shut Up and Wrestle! from your Backlash into your Ring and put your top 5 Arsenal cards under it, and put 1 F: 0 maneuver under Back to Basics into your Ring.

name: Warrior's Running Clothesline
Text: When played after a successfully played maneuver or Irish Whip, this card is a High Risk instead. Shuffle cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal up to the number of maneuvers in your Ring.

name: We Got a Lot of Heat in the Back For This Gimmick
Text: Packed: you cannot pack 'Interest' or 'Laid' cards. Your opponent cannot move this card from your Ring. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put 5- Hand cards under this card. Before the Draw Segment of the first turn of the game, put all cards under this card into your hand. Your Billy and Chuck-specific maneuvers and actions are Heat, and when your opponent plays a reversal card, draw 1-.

name: We Will BASH You...For Your Own Good!
Text: Your Superstar-specific action cards and your Takin' a BASH cards are Multi. Your BASH maneuvers are -4F. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may blank an opponent's revealed non-Enforcer Backstage card.

name: We're Takin' Over!
Text: Can only be played when you have 5 or more Fortitude lower than your opponent. Cannot be reversed if bWo is in your Ring. He skips his next turn. When you have more action cards in your Ring than he has in his Ring, your maneuvers are +2D and when he plays a maneuver, he may discard an action card; if he does not, his maneuver is -2D.

name: WHAT A RUSH!
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your maneuvers are +1D and your opponent's maneuvers are -1D. ACE: Once during each of your turns, when he has reversed your maneuver from hand, Backlash, or Ringside, you may discard up to 2 Backlash cards; when 1 card was put into your Ringside (or removed from the game) with this effect, your turn continues; when 2 cards were put into your Ringside (or removed from the game) with this effect, you may also put the reversed card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Whirlwind Kick
Text: You may search for this card as if it was non-Unique. Put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you have a Revolution card in your Ring, this card is +4D and cannot be reversed by reversal cards greater than D: 2.

name: Who Is The Blue Blazer?
Text: Put up to # cards from your Ringside and up to # cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal, where # is the number of maneuvers in your Ring. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card in your Ringside and reveal Super Masks and Super Capes.

name: Who Wants an Escort For the Night?
Text: Cannot be blanked. When packing this card, you cannot pack WWE Divas: The Next Generation, and your Action: Run-in cards with a female's name in the title are Unique, but they are not Cheater or Fan Favorite. Your Action: Run-in cards with a female's name in the title are F: 0 when played and cannot be reversed; ACE: you can remove one in your Ring from the game to reverse a non-Unique non-maneuver card.

name: Whoooo!
Text: Reverse any non-Superstar-Specific non-maneuver card.

name: Wild Shoot Promo
Text: When you have 15+ lower Fortitude, your opponent cannot respond to this card, and choose both options. Choose one: Bury #- Ringside cards, or they overturn # (# = total Ring maneuvers).

name: X-treme Dive Over the Ropes
Text: Can be packed by Lita or X-Treme Diva. Can only be played after a successfully played card. When you are an Extremist and have a Revolution card in your Ring, this card is an Extreme instead of a High Risk.

name: Yo Yo Yo Yo Yo Yo! Yo! Yo! ....yo.
Text: When this is not your opponent's first turn of the game and after he has successfully played a card and damage has been resolved, you may put this card into your Ring. End his turn.

name: You Better 'Get Smart'
Text: Choose 2 of your cards removed from the game, randomly put 1 in your hand and the other on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you are Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson or The Rock, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: You Can't Chain Up This Dog
Text: When packing this card, you may pack No Sell Maneuver cards. Your non-Multi non-Unique Grapple maneuvers are considered Chain. When JYD's Chain is successfully played, your opponent does not discard. Once during each of your turns, when JYD's Chain is removed from the game, you may put it into your hand.

name: You Shall Address Me As KING Booker!
Text: When packing this card, your Don't Hate da Playa, Hate da Game! cards are not Heel cards and cannot be reversed. Your Superstar-specific cards and your WCW Title Belt do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring, your Booker T-specific Strike maneuvers are Multi, and your opponent cannot play I'm Gonna Break You. When you are Booker T and successfully play a Superstar-specific maneuver, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: ¿Que Pasa Aqui?
Text: This card cannot be put under We Lie, We Cheat, We Steal. Search your Arsenal for 1 card, then put that card, 1 card in your hand and up to 1 card from your Ringside under We Lie, We Cheat, We Steal. Shuffle your Arsenal.
